description: AT&T Inc. is a holding company incorporated under the laws of the State of Delaware in 1983 with principal executive offices in Dallas, Texas. It describes itself as a leader in providing connectivity services through its market focus areas of 5G and fiber, with fiber underpinning both the wired and wireless connectivity it delivers, a solid spectrum portfolio and spectrum obtained through Federal Communications Commission actions, and it also provides wireless service and equipment in Mexico. Corporate support costs and results from businesses no longer integral to its operations are reported as Corporate and Other, which reconciles its segment results to consolidated operating income.
